summary: Michigan State hired Oregon State coach Jonathan Smith, 44, as its next football coach on Saturday, replacing Mel Tucker, who was fired with cause amid sexual harassment allegations. Smith leaves his alma mater after six seasons, a 34-35 record and a 10-3 2022 season, as the Pac-12 collapses. He takes over a Spartans program that has struggled since Mark Dantonio's tenure and will enter the Big Ten without divisions in 2024.
one_line: Michigan State hired Oregon State's Jonathan Smith as football coach to replace the fired Mel Tucker, as the Pac-12 breaks apart.
key_facts: Michigan State announced Jonathan Smith, 44, as its next football coach on Saturday after six seasons at Oregon State.
Smith went 34-35 overall at Oregon State with a 1-1 bowl record; he was Beavers quarterback from 1998-2001.
In 2022 Oregon State went 10-3 and finished No. 17 in the AP Top 25, earning Smith Pac-12 Coach of the Year; it was the first 10-win season since 2006.
Smith's extension ran through February 2029 and paid $4.85 million annually.
Michigan State fired fourth-year coach Mel Tucker with cause midseason amid sexual harassment allegations by Brenda Tracy, which emerged two games into 2023.
Tucker had received a 10-year, $95 million extension after an 11-2 season in 2021; Michigan State then went 5-7 in 2022.
Harlon Barnett served as interim coach as Michigan State finished 4-8, ending with a 42-0 loss to Penn State.
Oregon State lost 31-7 at Oregon in the final week of the regular season, after starting 2023 at 8-2.
Smith was an assistant under Chris Petersen at Boise State (2012-13) and Washington (2014-17), including the 2016 Pac-12 title and College Football Playoff berth.
The Pac-12 is set to lose 10 of its 12 members before 2024; Oregon State and Washington State are the only ones not picked up by other power leagues.
Under Mark Dantonio (2010-17) Michigan State won 10 or more games six times in eight seasons.
In 2024 the Big Ten drops divisions; Michigan State plays Ohio State and Michigan but avoids Penn State, and travels to Eugene, Oregon, in early October.
